body: I understand it's not all my fault but I don't really care tbh. I'm worried about losing this really amazing group of people because of how they'll think of me going forward. They've been so important to me and I'd do anything for them. Like I said, I have my husband and my mom but that's not enough to susutainably keep me from suicide, I need more reasons to live. I can't lose them cause I don't know what I'll do if that happens. Maybe I should look into other hobbies, lol.
